description: An all-in-one marketing, sales, and CRM platform for agencies and businesses to manage leads, campaigns, and communications.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for marketplace apps, and private app access tokens for custom integrations.
credential_notes: Developers need a paid GoHighLevel account or agency subscription to access the marketplace/developer portal and create API apps.
api_notes: Comprehensive API v2 covering contacts, calendars, conversations, locations, opportunities, custom fields, and workflows.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by GoHighLevel.
rationale: Public REST APIs and OAuth2 are well-documented, but developers require a paid GoHighLevel subscription to create credentials and apps.
